tool_args.rationale: The paid observations contain irregular raw history and a coupled transient lag. Fit the recalled two-state memory mechanism numerically, reconstructing the initial memory with the exponential trapezoidal kernel and forecasting with RK4; fresh confirmation will test its predictive accuracy.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: These uncoupled models omit the observed history-dependent coupled transient and do not match the recalled memory mechanism.
The acquired batch provides the eight rows specified for fitting the four-parameter memory model; fresh confirmation is the appropriate next test.
